limitations: Broad provisional primary best matches retain confidence, conflicts and forced-assignment flags.
Initial seed contains neuronal, oligodendroglial, astrocytic and immune-associated groups; these are not10 Microglia states.
Core membership is selected provisional metadata, not final retention or singlet certification.
All-gene marker contrasts and mouse composition are descriptive; no genotype effect, P value or FDR is inferred.
No actual Allen fine mapping, TE counts, physical-molecule truth or final normalization is claimed.
